title: The 'not tortilla' Spicy Meaty Egg and Onion Slab

groups.label: Veg
items: 1 onion. White or spring onion. Why not both?

groups.label: Seasoning
items: A couple of pinches of chilli flakes

steps.label: Prep
instructions: Chop all ingredients roughly (no Michelin stars here).

steps.label: Cook
instructions: Heat oil in a non-stick pan (medium heat).
Fry chorizo/ham, then add onions → soften.
Add tomato, jalapeños, spices → cook 2 mins.
Sprinkle cheese over, let melt slightly.

steps.label: Egg Time
instructions: Pour beaten eggs evenly over mixture.
Cook 5 mins (edges should set, centre still jiggly).

steps.label: Flip
instructions: Use a large plate to flip the slab (like a giant omelette).
Slide back into pan, cook 5 mins more (or until set).
Alternatively there's a weird kind of stirring thing you can do.

steps.label: Serve
instructions: Slide onto plate or eat straight from the pan.

notes: Cheap swaps: Use bacon ends or jamón scraps.
Pantry heroes: Paprika, cumin last forever.
